verification_actions: Re-read AGENTS.md and validate instructions.jsonl; never rewrite history.
A new real task owner may claim NC-000 after release, but must arrange verification by a separate real agent; owner must not certify their own work.
Verify all inventory source repository commits and independently SHA-256 every file listed in inventory.
Run python -m unittest -q test_dag and python dag.py validate.
In fresh processes rerun RLT current champion addition and selected general core inference.
In a fresh process load standalone causal/weights.pt and verify numeric multiplication; distinguish MLP from native RLT attention.
In separate fresh processes test transformer_controller v1 and v2; record the v1 6/14 vs v2 14/14 difference if reproduced.
Run root run.py explicit shared_rlt_isa and rlt_attention_isa inference; assert 13 * 11 == 143 without symbolic execution in the model.
Record the exact command, environment, seed, model checkpoint hash, numerators/denominators, failures, model-vs-ROM boundary, scope, and limitations.
Verify source repos and champion remain untouched; do not run training or commit model weights as part of NC-000.
Create the receipt under artifacts/NC-000/baseline_receipt.json with real implementer/verifier identities.
Only then call python dag.py pass NC-000 --owner REAL_CURRENT_OWNER --verifier REAL_DISTINCT_VERIFIER --evidence artifacts/NC-000/baseline_receipt.json.
